messages:
anya: FYI I'm testing a quota-aware SLO banner in the console. Idea: when short-window burn looks risky we temporarily tighten notify thresholds and surface a banner with CTA. Want API contract + telemetry plan before I hook up charts.

oscar: API proposal: lightweight read endpoint for console to render exact effective state. GET /v1/tenants/:id/notify-config -> returns effective_threshold, effective_reason, notify_route and a small provenance tag. Example: 

```json
{
  "effective_threshold": "0.85",
  "effective_reason": "quota_projection_high",
  "notify_route": "pager",
  "provenance": "historical+quota",
  "cache_control": "s-maxage=30, stale-while-revalidate=60"
}
```

oscar: keep payload tiny so the console call is cheap and cachable. Include cache_control and an etag so we can SWR.

leah: telemetry: we need 15m and 1h burn rates per-tenant plus a rolling slope metric (24h). current monthly meter won't cut it. I'll add a sampled metric stream (safety-sample 0.1% by tenant, full for internal tenants) and a derived 1h/15m series in prometheus.

devex: UX notes: banner copy should be explicit and actionable, e.g. "Alert thresholds temporarily tightened due to rising quota usage — request more capacity or view rule". Show a tiny inline projection sparkline (15m slope) and a tooltip with effective_reason. Also include an info link about false positives.

mike: API perf asks: make endpoint cachable (s-maxage small), return effective_threshold so UI doesn't duplicate logic, and include a reason_code ENUM (quota_spike, manual_override, historical_shift). For canary alerts include header X-rc:canary in outgoing webhook so oncall can filter.

andre: ops: for canary we should route pages flagged with X-rc:canary to a dedicated low-priority queue (canary-pager) or suppress by default. Also add an alert tag canary=true in telemetry so we can query false positive rate easily.

srebot: [incident-bot] New rule created: infra.alerts.notify_config_errors -> fires if /v1/tenants/:id/notify-config returns 5xx or times out > 2m.

leah: timeline: I'll land the 15m/1h burn metrics pipeline change (ETA 48h) and a sampled event stream for manual overrides (ETA 72h). Will also emit notify_policy_source tag = [historical, quota_projection, manual].

oscar: rollout plan: FF the API + UI behind tenant-canary=4% by token-volume, and an internal-only toggle that routes 25% of internal test tenants through quota-aware policies. We'll collect signal_quality + false_positive_rate.

mike: agreement: mute canary pages by severity/queue mapping; but also keep a small subset of canary pages routed to normal oncall for realism. Two-week observation window once canary is stable. Define metrics: weekly_false_positives, notify_lift_rate, SLO_regression_count.

devex: tiny addition: include a short rationale string for the banner so product docs can reuse it. Also prefer the banner to have a dismiss that persists per-user for 24h.

anya: action items summary: leah -> emit 15m/1h burn + provenance tags (48h). oscar -> PR for GET /v1/tenants/:id/notify-config with cache headers & etag (3d). devex -> banner mock + tooltip copy + dismiss behavior (48h). mike -> canary routing + X-rc header mapping (2d). andre -> canary pager queue config (2d). I'll wire console to call the endpoint behind FF and display effective_threshold + reason. We'll reconvene after metrics land.

anya: goal is to avoid surprise quota-triggered SLO pages while keeping false positive risk visible. Plan to run canary for 2 weeks, then decide wider rollout if weekly_false_positives does not increase > 10%.

mike: :thumbsup: Good plan. Let's make the API contract explicit in the PR description so devex can implement exactly.

anya: thanks all — copying this into the rollout doc and opening the ticket for the canary. :rocket:
